episodes.title: The Rules of the Beast
episodes.summary: 1897. English lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to meet a new client - and a legend is about to get fresh blood...

episodes.title: Blood Vessel
episodes.summary: The Russian ship The Demeter is a perfectly ordinary vessel, but her new voyage seems different. A motley collection of remarkable passengers includes one Count Dracula. Soon the crew are locked in a life-or-death struggle to stop the vampire before he reaches England. The ship of death has a new captain...

episodes.title: The Dark Compass
episodes.summary: Count Dracula has made it to England—a new world pulsing with fresh blood—and lays his plans to spread his foul vampire contagion. But why does he set his sights on the seemingly ordinary Lucy Westenra? And who on earth is left to stop him?
